prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: six-pose transparent sprite atlas for The Daily Meili isometric pixel office. Input 1 is the Pip style reference; input 2 is Meili the real corgi identity reference. Create Meili, a slim orange and white Pembroke corgi with tall ears, tapered muzzle, tiny black dot eyebrows, simple black eyes, white blaze like her photo, wearing a fitted pale grey sweater and short dusty PINK pleated skirt with white details. No wig, no glasses, no collar extras. Same bold chunky pixel art as Pip, no fuzzy gradients. Cute and elegant, not chunky or long. Dog anatomy, four legs, walks quadrupedal.
1536x1024 sheet, 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal cells, all poses completely isolated by generous transparent gutters. NO text, labels, shadow background or grid. Each sprite entirely inside its cell.
TOP row: 1 Meili seated upright at rest, three quarter facing right, front paws connected to torso; 2 Meili standing FOUR LEGGED facing right, holding the neck of a tiny pale sage glass bottle in her mouth, folded ivory letter inside with a red seal; 3 same dog at chute drop-off, FOUR paws on ground, head tilted upward, mouth open a little just released the bottle (do not draw a chute or free floating bottle).
BOTTOM row: 3 subtly different consecutive walk-cycle frames walking RIGHT on FOUR legs with SAME small bottle gently carried by the neck in her mouth. Her skirt falls only over her rear haunches, doesn't hide her feet, body slim and compact. Clearly attached shoulders and paws. Transparent background preserved. Match pixel density, sturdy outline and orange/white identity to Pip style, but face and pink skirt unmistakably Meili.
